title: Skin Panel Doubler Repair at the Forward Cargo Door Surround Lower Corner
abstract: Permanent external doubler repair for a skin panel crack at the lower corner of the forward cargo door surround, with the fastener pattern and the aerodynamic smoothness class required at that station.

sections.purpose: Permanent repair of a crack in the fuselage skin panel at the lower corner of the forward cargo door surround, using an external doubler with a stepped edge.
sections.damage_assessment: The damage is a crack initiating at the lower corner of the door cut-out, running diagonally into the skin panel. The assessment must establish whether the crack has reached the doorstop fitting; a crack that has entered the fitting is outside this scheme. The panel thickness at the repair station must be measured, because the stepped doubler is sized against it. Corrosion is frequently found under the existing sealant at the same location and must be removed and assessed before the doubler is fitted, since a doubler over unremoved corrosion traps moisture and the repair fails from underneath. The skin panel behind the doubler must be inspected by ultrasonic for subsurface indications before the repair is bonded.
sections.repair_procedure: Remove the door surround sealant and the protective treatment in the repair area. Establish the crack extent by eddy current. Stop-drill the crack tip at the position shown on repair drawing RD-53-21-12-007. Remove any corrosion and confirm the remaining thickness is within limits. Prepare the doubler landing area to the surface preparation standard. Position the external doubler using the panel D5321120233029 and the reinforcement item D5321123676082 as shown, with the stepped edge outboard so that the step faces aft of the airflow. Drill the fastener pattern through doubler and skin, cold expanding each hole where the declared standard applies. Install the fasteners wet using the collars D5321123957892 and the retaining hardware D5321127879224. Fit the closing strip D5321129450888 along the lower edge. Apply the aerodynamic fillet sealant along the doubler periphery and finish to the smoothness class stated.
sections.inspection_requirements: Eddy current inspection of the stop-drilled hole and of the fastener rows after installation. Ultrasonic inspection of the skin panel under the doubler is not possible after the repair, so the pre-repair ultrasonic record is the baseline and must be retained. A repeat eddy current inspection of the doubler fastener rows is required every 4 000 flight cycles. The aerodynamic fillet must be inspected at every A-check for loss of adhesion at the leading edge of the doubler.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Cracks up to 60 mm in the skin panel, not entering the doorstop fitting and not closer than 25 mm to an existing repair.

repair_drawings.title: External stepped doubler, fwd cargo door lower corner

type_data.fastener_pattern: Three rows, 46 fasteners, 22 mm pitch, 16 mm edge distance, staggered at the stepped edge
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is not life limited, but a repeat eddy current inspection of the doubler fastener rows is required every 4 000 flight cycles.
